name: Theek Hai Bhai
hooks: {topic} — batao tum bhi wahi karte ho?
{topic} — ye tumhare ghar me bhi hota hai.
line_bank: Mummy: beta padh rahe ho? Main: haan. Screen: 47 tabs khuli hain.
Wifi slow ho to zindagi ruk jaati hai, kaam nahi.
'Bas 5 minute' — 2 ghante baad.
Chai ke bina subah itni hi possible hai jitni exam bina padhai.
Papa ka dialogue: main tumhari umar me cycle se 12 km jaata tha.
Group project ka matlab: ek kaam karta hai, baaki credit lete hain.
Salary aayi, 4 din me gayab.
Alarm 7 baje bajta hai, uthna 7:40 pe hota hai.
'Kal se gym' — kal se hi kabhi nahi aata.
Shopping me budget nahi, mood decide karta hai.
Relatives ka sabse dangerous sawal: ab padhai kaisi chal rahi hai?
Phone 1 percent par ho to duniya ka sabse fast insaan ban jaate ho.
Photo ke liye 15 try, par real life me ek bhi dikhne ki himmat nahi.
Sunday night ka mood: kal Monday hai.
Khaane ke baad neend, neend ke baad guilt.
Chat me seen karke reply 3 din baad — strategy hai.
Dost ka plan: bulao mat, main aa raha hoon. Aata kabhi nahi.
Naye kapde mehngi, purane comfortable — life ka conflict.
Exam me jo aata nahi, wahi question 10 marks ka hota hai.
Login ke waqt password bhool jaana, reset me 20 minute.
cta: Relatable laga to follow kar lo, roz hasate rahenge.
